dashboard.label: TA-service Overview
dashboard.description: Collects systemd service health: total/active/failed unit counts and the list of failed units (with substate) via systemctl. Emits JSON events to index=main (sourcetype

search.query: | mstats avg("service.units_total") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("service.active_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="service:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | spath input=_raw output=f path=failed_units{} | mvexpand f | stats count(f) as value
index=main sourcetype="service:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=failed_units{} | mvexpand x | rename x as "unit" | table host "unit"
